The new stats

  • Shots fired / hit → accuracy = hits ÷ shots. 155 bot-games (11%) show accuracy above 100%, which usually means weapons that register several hits per shot (shotguns, splash or beams). Compare accuracy between similar classes rather than as an absolute.
  • Headshots → headshot rate = headshots ÷ hits.
  • Ults used → shown per 10 minutes on the field so long games don't dominate.
  • Per-minute rates use each bot's own time on the field, not the full game length.

Pearson r between each bot setting and each stat (±1 = perfectly linked, 0 = unrelated); ρ is the rank-based version, which is less affected by extreme values.
